reviews.text: Absolutely incredible first-time experience at VEG. All staff is highly knowledgeable, professional and compassionate. My 13-year old Pom received exceptional care! I highly recommend VEG to all pet parents!

We brought our beloved cat Banana to VEG Upper East Side during one of the most heartbreaking moments our family has experienced. From the moment we arrived, the entire team treated Banana and our family with extraordinary kindness, urgency, and compassion.
They rushed her in immediately and worked tirelessly to try to help her. Unfortunately, Banana was critically ill and we ultimately had to make the devastating decision to say goodbye. Throughout every moment, the staff were incredibly gentle with her and with us. They explained what was happening, gave us time with her before and after, and helped our sweet girl transition peacefully, surrounded by the people who loved her.
There is no way to make losing a beloved pet easy, but the care and dignity they gave Banana made an unbearable experience a little gentler. We will always be grateful for how hard they tried to save her and for the compassion they showed our family when saving her was no longer possible.
Thank you for taking such beautiful care of our sweet Banana. We will never forget the kindness you showed her, or us. 🍌🐱🤍
Thankful to Doctor Kass and CEC Erick. They both were incredible, thoughtful and assuring working with my cat , Simba’s stomach emergency. Recommended them as well as the spotless open facility!
They need be off they phones and pay attention then gossip and being on social media and ft when patients are in the room
Everyone was very nice and sweet very helpful running in last minute for my cat.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cannot say enough about the amazing care Misu Misu received at VEG on the Upper East Side. From the moment we walked in, everyone treated us with kindness, compassion, patience, and genuine concern.

A very special thank you to Dr. Larkin, Nurse Katherine, Assistant Dinesha, and Annie. You each made such a difficult and emotional situation feel a little easier. The way you cared for Misu Misu, explained everything to me, answered my questions, and showed so much compassion meant more than I can put into words.

I also want to thank the entire VEG staff—from the front desk team to the nurses, assistants, doctors, and everyone working behind the scenes. Everyone we met made us feel supported and cared for. Misu Misu never felt like just another patient. It felt like everyone truly cared about her and about how worried I was.

When your pet is sick or in an emergency, they are family, and trusting someone with them can be very emotional. I am so grateful that such a wonderful team surrounded Misu Misu.

Thank you all for your patience, kindness, professionalism, and, most of all, for treating Misu Misu with so much love and care. I will never forget how supported you made us feel. Thank you to the entire team for everything you do!
We had to urgently take my dog here and the staff was so so kind. Highly reccomend everyone was so sweet and took such good care of my baby bear. Thank you all so much!!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your trust in us.

The staff here is incredible. They treat all of the pets with incredible care and love. We're so grateful for the team here. Dr. Dehaan and Nurse John are incredible humans and we cannot be more satisfied with the care we received.

My dog is anxious, struggles to meet new people and go to new places. She only likes to walk in areas she knows, and although she loves to play she is reactive on leash to other dogs. Obviously, coming into the emergency room was very nerve-wracking.

My dog felt so safe at VEG - after our 10 hour visit, when we went outside to wait for our car home - she tried to go back inside the building. Have you ever heard of a dog trying to go back inside the vet’s office?

In the middle of a chaotic night - every single person at VEG made me and my dog feel seen, cared for, and safe. They kept me updated all night even as they were helping other people’s pets. Every person still found time to meet my dog on her terms and approach slowly so that she felt 100% comfortable being examined. This is a dog that usually does not let people touch her - and every single nurse and doctor in the office was giving her pets by the end of the visit.

I wish I got the names of everyone who helped me last night, but I want to say thank you especially to Isabella, Kat, and Dr. Rushing who were incredible all night long. Going to the vet is scary in part because I worry that I won’t know what’s happening and my dog is going to be taken away from me. My dog was able to wait sleeping in my lap, so she was calm and comfortable during the entire wait. Everyone included me in the conversations and discussions about her care, answered my questions with details, and was just overall kind.

Although my dog was not staying overnight at VEG, we were there waiting for quite some time as we happened to be there on a very busy night. I got to see the vet team do several rounds of check ins on their overnight surgical and boarding pets - not just taking vitals and doing a check in with the entire vet team for each animal, but also cuddling each one.

Everyone at VEG goes above and beyond to help take care of your pet, and you. Sometimes there is a wait because it is an emergency room, but I NEVER felt forgotten or pushed aside! Because of their open set up, the team was able to quickly update me on what was happening and I was able to understand why there was a delay, rather than just being left in the dark for hours with no idea what was happening. Also, the vet team was able to check in on her still and I was not worried that her condition was deteriorating during the wait. I felt confident that her condition was stable and she was safe.

I was able to pick my dog up and put her on the table myself (which was my preference) and be right there next to her when she opened her eyes after the procedure. I noticed her eyes were a little watery afterwards and asked if this was normal, and one of her doctors told me that they put eye drops in for her so her eyes didn’t get dry because they stay open during the procedure. I’ve heard of this for dogs in surgery, but the fact that that after a crazy holiday chaotic shift, they still paid attention to that small detail to make sure my dogs eyes didn’t get uncomfortable during her 30 minute procedure, that says it all for me.

It is also worth mentioning that when they gave me the estimate to authorize, there was a $200 item for “additional miscellaneous.” I asked about the fee and they explained it was to cover anything unexpected that might have to be done during the procedure, but that I would be refunded at the end if it was not necessary. I didn’t even have to ask or remind anyone about this at the end of our visit - part of our discharge information was the team informing that there were no additional charges and the refund had already been processed. WOW!

I could go on with many more examples, but I will end by saying thank you VEG.❤️ Next time I will get more names for everyone who helped me so I can properly say thank you. If you have an emergency, take your pet to VEG. (photos of my dog resting after her procedure and then trying to return to the building after we left)
Just go to AMC hospital a few blocks away . I took my dog here and was poorly diagnosed and treated . I left this place and went to Amc where dog was admitted for 4 days . I don’t recommend.

Klay, my cat, was barely eating for days due to a kidney issue, and after being treated by the amazing staff at VEG, he regained his appetite! His kidney lab results also improved significantly!

Everyone was so kind, patient, and informative!

There are so many people to thank! Dr. Lee, Dr. Eickhoff, Dr. Rushing, Isabella, and others whose names I don’t have at the moment! The doctor who treated him on Sunday was incredible as well and I feel bad for not knowing her name. She gave me the reassurance I needed to bring Klay home and when he returned for a follow up on Monday, his lab results were stellar!

One of the nurses/vet techs helped me pick out kidney friendly food for him and he was immediately in love with it, as shown in the photo!

Klay is feisty, and I’m so grateful for the staff who gave him his meds, hooked up his catheters, fed him, and kept him company!

Thank you again! ❤️❤️‍🩹

The veterinary staff at VEG Upper East Side went above and beyond to help my dog, Palmetto. Dr. Kass was one of the most knowledgeable and compassionate veterinarians I have ever interacted with, and I could not recommend her more.

After a week of various vet visits, procedures, and a trip to the emergency room, I was out of options and completely desperate to help my best friend. The staff here went well above what is expected of them to make me feel informed, comforted, and safe. Plus they did a remarkable job on my dog’s surgery.

I could not recommend this team more. They took what was the worst day of my life, a day where I thought I might have to euthanize my dog and best friend, and gave me hope. Ten out of ten stars. 🩷

I never share reviews but feel like I have to here; the staff answered the phone right away and encouraged me to come in with my dogs symptoms, opened the door for me when I got there, and basically whisked me right back into a room. My girl was seen and treated so quickly and with so much care!

Awesome pet care.
Awesome experience
Awesome hospitality
Thank you. Randi & I are forever grateful

Having to bring your beloved pet to the ER is always stressful, never fun, and filled with so much uncertainty. I have had to bring in my little girl two times, and both times we were met with compassion, warmth, and empathy. Doctor Serra was phenomenal and extremely forward and human. I so badly wish I could remember the name of the triage tech, she had cool blue locks, but she was also incredibly chill and compassionate and immediately set a calm tone for the whole visit. I asked so many ridiculous, anxious questions and both met me with information and care. The whole team took great care of my little girl, who is completely blind and was quite spicy on account of the pain she was in. I of course hope I never have to go to the ER vet again... But if I do, I'm choosing this VEG location every single time. Thank you again for making an extraordinarily stressful night a bit less so, and for the quick and thorough care of miss Rosalie.
VEG has been nothing but kind to our dog Loki for all the times we have had to bring him in. They are patient, kind, and offered solutions before we even brought him in.

A truly exceptional vet practice. Dr. Marderstein treated my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel through an ER assessment and overnight hospital stay. The staff enabled me to stay with my dog the entire time; he even spent part of the hospitalization on my lap. We received prompt, transparent, and compassionate care throughout.

We are particularly thankful for Natalie and Anika who went above and beyond to care for Freddie and ensure he was doted on.

Each step of the treatment was clearly communicated. Unlike other practices, his treatment actually came in at the lowest end of the financial estimate.

Before going to VEG, we visited a standard ER. They would have separated my dog for the duration of the treatment, which is incredibly stressful for a cavalier. The VEG approach is focused on holistic wellbeing for the dog, which includes involving the owner in the process.

I am so grateful to the entire VEG team!
